source.verification_required: Captured source text only from the official DCP Zoning Resolution portal: the section's canonical HTML (node 22706; raw_html_sha256 pinned) and its print/PDF render (cross_check; raw_pdf_sha256 pinned). The verbatim excerpt was extracted PROGRAMMATICALLY from the raw HTML bytes (the sec-body field--name-body container) and compared block-by-block against the print/PDF text layer (every block found verbatim). It has NOT been re-read by a second agent, so raw_html_verified stays false and extraction_status stays extracted_draft. Nothing in this record is a rule, a reading of the text for any lot, a derived or computed number, or an eligibility determination; it is the official source text of one ZR section only. Nothing here is a Verified zoning determination (ADR-007: a rule citing it ships under the standing not-professionally-reviewed label with a direct source link; professional review is advisory).

cross_check.method: The section's print/PDF render (entityprint/pdf/node/22706, 302 -> /print/pdf/node/22706) was retrieved (HTTP 200, application/pdf, raw_pdf_sha256 pinned) and its text layer read with pdftotext. The HTML-derived verbatim_excerpt was split into 4 blocks (one per paragraph/list item) and each block's prose was confirmed to appear verbatim in the PDF text layer (compared lowercase, straight-quote, whitespace- and hyphen-insensitive). All 4 blocks matched. The only systematic PDF-text-layer artifact is an intermittently dropped hyphen in section cross-references (e.g. '27-10' rendered '2710'); the canonical HTML keeps the hyphen and the stored excerpt uses the HTML form. The outline labels (a)/(1)/(i), cycling every three list depths, are the labels the PDF render prints; the HTML carries them only as <ol> nesting.

verbatim_excerpt:
The Mandatory Inclusionary Housing Program shall apply in #Mandatory Inclusionary Housing areas#.

The Mandatory Inclusionary Housing Program shall also apply in special purpose districts when specific zoning districts or areas are defined as #Mandatory Inclusionary Housing areas# within the special purpose district.

Additionally, the Mandatory Inclusionary Housing Program shall apply as a condition of City Planning Commission approval of special permits as set forth in Section 74-06 (Additional Considerations for Special Permit Use and Bulk Modifications), in special purpose districts as set forth in Section 27-134 (Special permit approval in special purpose districts) and in waterfront areas as set forth in Section 62-831 (General provisions).

#Mandatory Inclusionary Housing areas#, with the applicable income mix options for each #Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area#, are listed in APPENDIX F of this Resolution.
verbatim_excerpt_composition: Verbatim blocks of the section body (the sec-body field--name-body container), joined by blank lines, in page order. Each paragraph and each list item is one block. A list item carries a parenthesised outline label matching the official print/PDF render, which prints them ((a)/(b)... at the first list depth, (1)/(2)... at the second, (i)/(ii)... at the third, cycling every three depths); the HTML supplies only <ol> nesting, so the labels are the render's. Defined terms (bold-italic <strong><em> in the HTML) are written #term#, exactly as the print/PDF render writes them, inner spacing preserved (a bold-italic span that in the source spans connective text renders its # markers at the span boundary, e.g. 'HPD# may issue a #permit notice#', faithfully kept). Runs of whitespace and non-breaking spaces are written as one space and each block is trimmed; embedded figures are omitted; no word was changed. The section number and title are recorded in section_number/section_title and are not repeated in the excerpt.
